content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Leases aircraft and engines, repairs components and sells used serviceable engine parts to airlines and lessors, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Mainly casino management, with business jet modifications and avionics as a separate, different business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Runs vehicle salvage auctions and yards, a different business from aircraft engine leasing and repair."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Diversified manufacturer of valves, pumps and composite panels, with aerospace parts as only one segment."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Distributes industrial MRO supplies and test equipment, not aircraft engines or engine leasing."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Provides in-flight internet connectivity and subscriptions, not engine leasing, maintenance or parts."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Designs and builds avionics such as flight displays and autopilots, a different product from aircraft engines."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pumps, valves, brake pads and connectors for industrial customers, not aircraft engines."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Rents and services natural gas compressors for oil and gas producers, a different asset and customer base."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures engines and generator sets sold to equipment makers, not leasing aircraft engines to airlines."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Builds business jets, helicopters and defense vehicles, with aircraft sales rather than engine leasing as its core."}]}
